lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"In this room, we are[01]holding a group of[01]people who were part[02]of an incident which[01]is currently under[01]investiga...[02]Hey, what're you[01]doing out here!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Nesta sala, estamos[01]detendo um grupo de[02]pessoas que fizeram parte[01]de um incidente que[01]esta sob investigacao...[02]Ei, o que voces[01]fazem aqui!?"

lines.text_source: "Back when we were[01]at war,[02]things were really[01]busy here, what with[02]everyone making[01]machines, selling[01]parts and all..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Quando estávamos em[01]guerra, as coisas[02]eram muito movimentadas[01]aqui, com todos[02]fazendo máquinas,[01]vendendo peças e tal..."

lines.text_source: "Here, we use the[01]metal prospected[02]from the dam to[01]make machine parts."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Aqui, usamos o metal[01]prospectado da barragem[02]para fazer peças de[01]máquina."

lines.text_source: "I came here from the[01]south, and while I[02]was passing through[01]the woods,[02]something poked me[01]in the eye![02]I tell you, that[01]forest is haunted!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Vim do sul, e enquanto[01]passava pela floresta,[02]algo me bateu no olho![02]Te digo, aquela[01]floresta e assombrada!"

lines.text_source: "I just know there's[01]something in that[01]forest![02]I mean, you'll hear[01]voices when there's[01]nobody around,[02]and sometimes you[01]can feel something[02]pulling your hair![02]Some people say[01]they've even been[02]bit by invisible[01]animals!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Tenho certeza que tem algo[01]naquela floresta![02]Voces ouvem vozes[01]quando nao ha ninguem,[02]e às vezes sentem algo[02]puxando seu cabelo![02]Alguns dizem que ate[01]foram mordidos por[02]animais invisiveis!"

lines.text_source: "I was traveling[01]through the forest,[01]when suddenly[02]something pinched[01]my...Well, my you-[01]know-where!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Estava passando pela[01]floresta, quando algo[02]repentinamente me[01]beliscou... bem, em[01]lugar... privado!"

lines.text_source: "Ain't had much to[01]do since the war[01]ended..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Nao tenho muito a[01]fazer desde que a[01]guerra terminou..."

lines.text_source: "Can't find any work,[01]but that doesn't stop[01]him from eating!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Nao consegue trabalho,[01]mas isso nao o[01]impede de comer!"

lines.text_source: "Not only did a lot[01]of people lose their[02]jobs when the war[01]ended,[02]now they've got all[01]sorts of problems with[01]the truce...[02]I sure don't envy the[01]king his job!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Nao so muitos perderam[01]emprego quando a guerra[02]terminou, agora tem[01]tudo tipo de problema[02]com a trégua...[02]Nao gostaria de estar[01]no lugar do rei!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Have you heard what[01]they're saying about[02]the chief of the[01]Worens?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][83]C"I have! They say[01]he snuck into the[02]Empire searching for[01]the missing Wyndian[01]princess!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Ja ouviram o que[01]andam dizendo do[02]chefe dos Worens?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][83]C"Ouvi! Dizem que[01]ele entrou sorrateiro[02]no Imperio procurando[01]a princesa de Wyndia[01]desaparecida!"
lines.risk_notes: multiplos speakers, risco de confusao de vozes com tags [14][02][02] e [14][FF][FF][14][83]C

lines.text_source: [14][03][03]"Can you believe[01]it? I mean, she's[01]engaged, isn't she?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][82]B"I know! To the[01]Prince of Ludia,[01]no less![02]I just love royal[01]scandals!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: compartilhar escandalo real, expressar prazer no drama
lines.base_translation: [14][03][03]"Acreditam nisso?[01]Quer dizer, ela esta[01]noiva, nao esta?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][82]B"Sei! Do Príncipe de[01]Ludia, nada menos![02]Adoro escandalo real!"
lines.risk_notes: multiplos speakers com tags [14][03][03] e [14][FF][FF][14][82]B; glossario: 'Princess' = 'princesa', 'Prince' = 'Príncipe'

lines.text_source: "All my mom does is[01]stand around all day[01]and gossip!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Tudo que minha mae faz[01]e ficar em pe o dia[01]todo e fofoquear!"

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"It is unacceptable![02]Zese factory towns,[01]zey do not 'ave any[01]inns![02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "[14][04][04]Isto e inaceitavel![02]Estas cidades fabris,[01]elas nao tem nenhuma[01]pousada![02][19]
lines.risk_notes: personagem com sotaque aleatorio; '[19]' marca fim prematuro ou corte — preservar exato

lines.text_source: [14][80]@"Can you believe it?[02]I had no idea the[01]Prince was so cold-[01]hearted!"[02][14][FF][FF][14][01][01]"Maybe so, but I[01]bet people in his[02]position have to be[01]like that in order[02]to do what they have[01]to do."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: expressar julgamento e depois justificar frieza politica
lines.base_translation: [14][80]@"Acreditam nisso?[02]Nao fazia ideia de que[01]o Príncipe era tao[01]frio!"[02][14][FF][FF][14][01][01]"Talvez, mas aposto[01]que pessoas na posicao[02]dele precisam ser assim[01]para fazer o que[02]precisam fazer."
lines.risk_notes: dialogo duplo [14][80]@ e [14][01][01]; risco de perda de personalidade de speaker; preservar tokens exatos

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Do you think the[01]Woren chief knew[01]what would happen[02]to him if he went[01]to the Empire, but[01]went anyway?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][80]@"I guess he must[01]really love the[02]Princess to do[01]that for her."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.intent: questionar sacrificio e depois interpretá-lo como amor
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Voces acham que o[01]chefe Woren sabia[01]o que aconteceria[02]com ele se fosse ao[01]Imperio, mas foi[01]mesmo assim?"[02][14][FF][FF][14][80]@"Acho que ele deve[01]amar muito a[02]princesa para fazer[01]isso por ela."
lines.risk_notes: Fou-Lu pode ser speaker aqui (Woren chief context); dialogo cruzado [14][FF][FF] marca transicao; preservar exato; 'Princess' = 'princesa'

lines.text_source: [14][04][04]"Is dangerous to be[01]walking around at[01]night like zis, no?[02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "[14][04][04]E perigoso andar por[01]aqui a noite assim,[02]nao?[02][19]

lines.text_source: You've got to go help[01][04][02]!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Voces precisam ir ajudar[01][04][02]!"

lines.text_source: "shhh! Don't let my[01]wife know where I am![02]If she finds out I'm[01]not working, she'll[01]have my hide!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Psiu! Nao deixem minha[01]esposa saber onde[02]estou! Se ela descobrir[01]que nao estou[01]trabalhando, vou ficar[01]em apuros!"

lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Agora para onde aquele[01]marido sem-vergonha[02]meu foi dessa[01]vez!?"

lines.text_source: "Been seeing a lot of[01]Ludian troops moving[02]out of the capital[01]lately...[02]Wonder if that means[01]another war's going[01]to start?"

lines.text_source: "Have you heard the[01]news?"[12]

lines.text_source: "They say the dam was[01]destroyed by a mud[01]flood![02]That means we won't[01]be able to get the[02]metal we need to[01]make parts.[02]What're we going to[01]do!?"

lines.base_translation: "Os Worens me disseram que[01]a floresta do sul e[01]assombrada, entao vim[02]ver por mim mesmo,[01]mas nao vi nenhum[01]fantasma!"
